requirements.text: The successful bidder shall design, supply, install, test and commission the grid-tied solar PV systems including obtaining net-metering approvals and provide operations and maintenance services for three (3) years from commissioning.
The bidder must perform site surveys and detailed engineering design for each hospital.
The bidder must supply Tier-1 solar PV modules, string inverters and mounting structures.
The bidder must execute civil and electrical installation works.
The bidder must provide SCADA-based remote monitoring with a central dashboard.
The bidder must liaise with DISCOs to obtain net-metering licenses/approvals.
The bidder must train hospital engineering staff.
The bidder must provide comprehensive O&M including performance guarantees for three (3) years.
Bidders failing any mandatory requirement shall be disqualified.
The bidder must have successfully completed at least two (2) solar PV or renewable energy projects each of contract value as specified in the RFP table (M1).
The bidder must hold a valid ISO 9001 quality management certification (M2).
The bidder must have prior experience working with federal or provincial government clients in Pakistan (M3).
The bidder must submit a bid security of two percent (2%) of the bid price in the form of a bank guarantee from a scheduled bank (M4).
The project manager assigned must hold a valid PMP certification with a minimum of eight (8) years of infrastructure project experience (M5).
The bidder must be registered with the Federal Board of Revenue and provide an active taxpayer certificate (M6).
Solar PV modules shall be Tier-1 with a minimum module efficiency of 21% and a 25-year linear performance warranty (T1).
The bidder should provide a SCADA or IoT-based remote monitoring solution with a centralized web dashboard covering all sites (T2).
The bidder should demonstrate in-house engineering capability for grid interconnection studies and protection coordination (T3).
All electrical works shall comply with IEC 62548 and the Pakistan Electricity Code (T4).
Installation teams should include licensed personnel as specified in the RFP clause (T4).
The bidder should propose a preventive maintenance plan with quarterly site visits and a 48-hour fault-response commitment (T5).
The bidder should describe its HSE policy and provide evidence of safe execution of works at operational healthcare facilities (T6).
The bidder should provide a structured training and knowledge-transfer program for hospital engineering staff (T7).
Bidders scoring less than 70 marks in the technical evaluation shall not be considered for financial evaluation.
The bid validity period shall be 120 days.
Proposals shall be submitted in two separate sealed envelopes marked "Technical Proposal" and "Financial Proposal".
The bidder must submit one original and two copies each of the Technical Proposal and the Financial Proposal.
Proposals shall be addressed to the Section Officer (Procurement), Energy Department, Government of Punjab, Lahore.
The bidder must respond to the required proposal sections Q1 to Q7 as listed in the RFP.
